objective: Reduce native-4K balcony material/texel risk without awarding visual points before real Unity pixels exist.

investigation.firstCandidate: The legacy detail builder assigns HD_BalconySlabLip an aged-aluminum material even though the element represents the concrete balcony slab fascia.
investigation.disposition: No duplicate change made. Existing QualityBlockBalconyConstructionInterfaceQA already documents this exact legacy defect, restores the fascia to the balcony-floor concrete material, seats it to the slab top and validates the final binding.
investigation.selectedIssue: The generated balcony waterproof micro-normal and metallic/smoothness textures are authored at 1024x1024 with millimetre-scale/subtle physical signals, while their generator imports them using CompressedHQ. Existing balcony microstructure QA validates dimensions, linear color space, mipmaps, filtering, anisotropy and PBR bindings but does not fail compressed runtime imports or Standalone compression overrides.
investigation.risk: Block compression can alter normal orientation or quantize smoothness before the formal 4K grazing view, creating avoidable texel/PBR instability even though the source PNG and material contract are correct.

changes.summary: Added machine-readable import-precision authority for both balcony microtextures: Uncompressed, no Crunch, >=1024, mipmapped, Repeat, Trilinear, anisotropy>=8, no Standalone override, linear data, canonical texture types and source alpha preservation. Automatic Visual Fidelity points remain zero.

Added preparation-time repair plus formal-camera read-only/fail-closed validation. Reimports both generated physical-data textures as Uncompressed, disables Crunch/Standalone override, preserves mip/trilinear/aniso, validates runtime size+mip presence, and reasserts precision after generated-source imports.
